args.question:
Evergreen Catering (V-951) has two approved invoices, so I can't tell which one is 'the one that's due' without your input:
- INV-53266: $4,268.44, due 2026-11-04
- INV-36368: $4,549.02, due 2026-11-25
(INV-52633 is a draft awaiting approval, and INV-32815 is already paid.)
Which invoice should I pay in full by wire from the operating account? I have not sent any payment yet.
